<Heading
  as={"h1"}

  children={"Get a receipt"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/receipts/{receiptId}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the receipt with its lines, state, version (also as the `ETag`)
and the discrepancies as they stand now (final once the receipt is
`Closed`).


<Heading
  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>

</Heading>

>
